name: Laser Tek Taiwan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Laser Tek Taiwan Co., Ltd. is a multifaceted enterprise with operations extending across Taiwan and into international markets. Its principal activities include the processing of surface-mounted devices (SMD), supplying surface mount technology (SMT) equipment, developing intelligent information systems for businesses, and delivering specialized laser precision solutions. The company's extensive portfolio also covers the production, processing, and distribution of laser trimming machinery and various printing materials. They are also involved in the design and sale of critical testing probe cards, as well as providing comprehensive solutions such as FDR information retrieval systems, LCD testing, and electronic test fixtures. Further diversifying its business, Laser Tek engages in the construction of lighting infrastructure, the trading and sale of electronic components, and the distribution of electrical appliances. The firm provides maintenance services for semiconductor equipment and components, installs solar thermal energy systems, and offers engineering and energy-related technical expertise, including acting as a trading agent. Additionally, the company manufactures equipment for pollution control, processes and markets packaging materials for electronic components, and specializes in the slitting, production, and sale of antistatic chip resistor packaging carrier tapes (both top and bottom variants). Its broad reach even encompasses the planning of cultural and artistic events, the distribution of chemical raw materials and food products, and facilitating the import and export of goods and technologies. Established in 1988, Laser Tek Taiwan Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
